title: POST /sites/{id}/users – request
description: Assign a user the caller can see to the site; only a user every site of whom is a site of the caller (otherwise 403 forbidden), as the new PIN goes to the caller. The user gets a new PIN (the given one, or a generated one returned once), unique among the users of all of their sites: the server only knows the hash of the old PIN, so it cannot check it against the users of the new site. A user already assigned to the site: nothing changes (no new PIN). Supervisor token, or the site phone's device token with an X-Acting-User header (then only on the phone's site). Requires an Idempotency-Key header. Response: 200, api/user.response.json.
